name: expense-api

dependencies.name: expense-db
dependencies.description: Stores employees, claims, line items and export batches.

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Validates the signed-in caller's token for every protected operation.

description: Owns expense claims, their line items, approval decisions and payroll export batches. Serves the employee's own claims, a manager's direct reports' claims, and finance's approved-but-unexported claims. Does not read receipts or extract data from them — that is the receipt agent's job.
